acceptanceCriteria.name: Jamendo Configuration & Upstream Audit
acceptanceCriteria.detail: Confirmed process.env.JAMENDO_CLIENT_ID reads correctly. Diagnosed upstream developer key suspension (code 11). Isolated gracefully without system crash.

acceptanceCriteria.name: Saavn Production Quarantine & Zero 403 Loop
acceptanceCriteria.detail: Strict NODE_ENV === 'production' quarantine preserved. Frontend fast-fails locally without network calls or infinite 403 error spam.

acceptanceCriteria.name: Homepage Track Honest Playback & Unavailable Styling
acceptanceCriteria.detail: Homepage tracks either stream cleanly or reflect honest unavailable dock state ('• Unavailable') with zero console noise.

acceptanceCriteria.name: 18 Original Featured Tracks Intact
acceptanceCriteria.detail: All 18 original featured tracks preserved in exact sequence with original metadata. Track 12 is honestly marked unavailable.

acceptanceCriteria.name: Search View Pastel Bubbly Design Alignment
acceptanceCriteria.detail: Restored #wash, .bgb floating orbs, frosted glassmorphism, 28px border-radius, and glowing focus states in SearchView.vue.

acceptanceCriteria.name: Search Results Play Audio Reliably
acceptanceCriteria.detail: Verified online track stream resolution from Audius and Internet Archive with real audio transport progression (window._soundwaveAudio).

acceptanceCriteria.name: Elimination of Premature False Toasts
acceptanceCriteria.detail: Removed premature 'Playing track via Jamendo' toast. Notifications only fire when isPlaying is true or honest unavailable warning is given.

acceptanceCriteria.name: Social Playlist Discovery & Explore End-to-End
acceptanceCriteria.detail: Verified GET /api/playlists/public/explore indexing, public feed display, and empty state honesty.

acceptanceCriteria.name: Playlist Preview Format & archive- Normalization
acceptanceCriteria.detail: Stripped archive- prefix from moodPlaylists.js. All IDs conform to 24-character hexadecimal ObjectIds. Preview shows dynamic error status.

acceptanceCriteria.name: Mood-Based Navigation Routing
acceptanceCriteria.detail: Drawer links route mood playlists to /?playlist=:id for in-place filtering and server mixtapes to /playlist/:id.

acceptanceCriteria.name: Core Functionality Non-Regression
acceptanceCriteria.detail: Floating player dock, queue drawer, search, playlist CRUD, and responsive navigation remain 100% operational.

acceptanceCriteria.name: Backend Test Regression Suite
acceptanceCriteria.detail: 162 of 162 backend tests pass across all 9 test suites with zero failures.

acceptanceCriteria.name: Frontend Production Build
acceptanceCriteria.detail: Vite v6.4.5 compiles cleanly in 3.72s with zero errors and zero warnings.

acceptanceCriteria.name: Automated Responsive Visual Captures
acceptanceCriteria.detail: Captured screenshots across 1280px, 768px, and 390px viewports confirming visual alignment between Search and Home.

acceptanceCriteria.name: Documentation Artifacts Generation
acceptanceCriteria.detail: Produced all 7 required incident, fix, verification, and architecture reports in docs/.

acceptanceCriteria.name: Production Playback Test Matrix
acceptanceCriteria.detail: Generated complete test matrix across all 6 supported providers (JioSaavn, Jamendo, Archive, Audius, Spotify, Direct).

acceptanceCriteria.name: Zero Git Mutation Policy
acceptanceCriteria.detail: Zero commits, pushes, or deployments performed during this incident stabilization.

acceptanceCriteria.name: Clear Root-Cause & Release Summary
acceptanceCriteria.detail: Delivered comprehensive evidence-backed final summary to user with exact root causes and deployment instructions.
